capabilities.title: macOS packaged home-base runtime
capabilities.acceptance: The built macOS bundle opens the Apple/home-base shell, includes the web runtime, manages backend/proxy explicitly, and supports local signing.

capabilities.title: Shared Apple core contracts
capabilities.acceptance: Shared Swift code has repeatable tests for pairing store, encrypted patient-list cache, patients client, launch overrides, Bonjour discovery, runtime status and optional service diagnostics.

capabilities.title: Mobile paired bootstrap and read
capabilities.acceptance: A booted iPhone/iPad simulator can receive temporary paired credentials, authenticate as operator, read network patients, launch MediFlowMobile and capture an artifact.

capabilities.title: Paired patient profile write
capabilities.acceptance: Network paired write for patient profile/status requires paired credentials, operator session, capability and version conflict handling.

capabilities.title: Paired diary write
capabilities.acceptance: Network paired diary create/update/soft-delete requires paired credentials, operator session, capability and entry version handling.

capabilities.title: Paired therapy write
capabilities.acceptance: Network paired therapy create/update/soft-delete requires paired credentials, operator session, capability and therapy version handling.

capabilities.title: Paired checkup write
capabilities.acceptance: Network paired checkup create/update/soft-delete requires paired credentials, operator session, capability and checkup version handling.

capabilities.title: Paired observation write
capabilities.acceptance: Network paired observation create/update/soft-delete requires paired credentials, operator session, capability and observation version handling.

capabilities.title: Mobile core CRUD UI
capabilities.acceptance: iPhone/iPad expose usable native list/detail/create/edit flows for the non-AI core modules.

capabilities.title: Mobile offline cache and explicit reconciliation
capabilities.acceptance: Mobile clients keep encrypted derived cache, show paired-offline-degraded state and reconcile writes explicitly when the home-base returns.

capabilities.title: Current Apple-wide click-map evidence
capabilities.acceptance: Automated probes cover the current macOS home-base shell, paired mobile simulator bootstrap/read, and paired network write/conflict boundaries; full mobile CRUD UI and offline reconciliation remain separate WUL-193 gaps.
